card.name: Small linking words before a drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as each, of, with and including that come right before a prescription, dose or a specific drug name in label text. Most often seen after words like with, before, treated or dose.

modes.label: each before prescription or dose
modes.description: The word each after with or before, ahead of prescription or dose.
modes.example: the importance of reading the Medication Guide with<< each>> prescription. ( 5.2 )

modes.label: of or with before a drug name
modes.description: The word of or with after dose or treated, just before the named drug.
modes.example: 2.3 Dosing Information The recommended starting dose<< of>> apomorphine hydrocloride

modes.label: including before an agent name
modes.description: The word including introduces a specific drug after a general class.
modes.example: has been reported with use of nearly all antibacterial agents,<< including>> cefpodoxime proxetil

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before the label names a drug, a dose or a prescription.
